% RQ4 2-set / 3-cell UpSet figure (Phase 43 Plan 04, REQ-V263-04 / D-06).
% Generated by transarc-emp/src/paper/rq4_table.py.
% Cells: only \linkerB{}, both, only \linkerC{}.
% BODY float for RQ4 (the "diff chart" that replaces the old overlap table table/rq4-agents.tex).
% !!! PLACEHOLDER COUNTS !!! The 129/21/26 bar values are the OLD s20_union Claude figures.
% NUMBERS PASS: replace with the gpt-5.4 s_linker21 set-overlap counts (only_E/both/only_C).
% Exact counts live in the appendix overlap table; the Claude mirror is appendix/rq4-upset-claude.tex.
\begin{figure}[t]
\centering
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  bar/.style={fill=darkblue,draw=black!70},
  dot/.style={circle,fill=black,inner sep=1.4pt},
  no-dot/.style={circle,draw=black!30,fill=white,inner sep=1.4pt},
  connect/.style={thick,black},
  label/.style={font=\scriptsize,anchor=east},
  axn/.style={font=\tiny,gray!60},
]
\def\cw{0.6}\def\bh{2.0}\def\rh{0.30}\def\maxct{129}

% --- top bar chart (3 cells) ---
\foreach \col/\ct/\lbl in {%
  0/129/{only \linkerB{}},%
  1/21/{both},%
  2/26/{only \linkerC{}}%
} {
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\bhc}{\bh * \ct / \maxct}
  \draw[bar] ({\cw*\col + 0.15*\cw},0) rectangle ({\cw*\col + 0.85*\cw},\bhc);
  \node[axn,anchor=south] at ({\cw*\col + 0.5*\cw},\bhc) {\ct};
}

% --- intersection matrix below (2 rows: \linkerB, \linkerC) ---
\foreach \row/\lk in {0/\linkerB{},1/\linkerC{}} {
  \node[label] at (-0.1,{-\rh*\row - 0.4}) {\lk};
  \foreach \col in {0,1,2} {
    \node[no-dot] at ({\cw*\col + 0.5*\cw},{-\rh*\row - 0.4}) {};
  }
}
% memberships:
% col 0: only \linkerB (Entity)
\node[dot] at ({\cw*0 + 0.5*\cw},-\rh*0 - 0.4) {};
% col 1: both
\node[dot] at ({\cw*1 + 0.5*\cw},-\rh*0 - 0.4) {};
\node[dot] at ({\cw*1 + 0.5*\cw},-\rh*1 - 0.4) {};
\draw[connect] ({\cw*1 + 0.5*\cw},-\rh*0 - 0.4) -- ({\cw*1 + 0.5*\cw},-\rh*1 - 0.4);
% col 2: only \linkerC (Coreference)
\node[dot] at ({\cw*2 + 0.5*\cw},-\rh*1 - 0.4) {};

\node[font=\scriptsize,anchor=south west,rotate=90] at (-1.0,0) {TPs in set};
\end{tikzpicture}
\caption{RQ4: UpSet-style summary of true-positive set membership across the two linker modules in \fullVariant{} \approach{} (GPT-5.4 backend). Dots in a column mark the linker(s) whose TP sets intersect; bar height = number of gold links in that intersection. Exact counts, the overlap table, and the Claude Sonnet backend are in \autoref{app:detailed}.}
\label{fig:rq4-upset}
\end{figure}
